rule_en: Review: trust the time markers — yesterday → past simple, since/for → perfect, right now → continuous, by + future time → future perfect, and reported speech shifts one step back.
rule_bn: সময়ের সূত্র দেখো: yesterday → past simple; since/for → perfect; right now → continuous; reported speech → এক ধাপ অতীতে।

sessions.title: Spot the Error
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the wrong word, then choose the fix.

items.prompt_en: Since the sprint started, I fixed eleven bugs
items.explain_en: 'Since' + an unfinished period takes the present perfect.

items.prompt_en: By the time QA opened the ticket, I already fixed the bug
items.explain_en: An action finished before another past action takes the past perfect.

items.prompt_en: She is talk to the client right now, so call back later
items.explain_en: 'right now' needs the present continuous: is + verb-ing.

items.prompt_en: I am working on this migration since Monday morning
items.explain_en: 'since Monday' needs the present perfect continuous for an action still going.

items.prompt_en: The server crashed while I deployed the new package
items.explain_en: A longer background action interrupted in the past takes the past continuous.

items.prompt_en: We will to release the hotfix as soon as the tests pass
items.explain_en: 'will' takes the bare verb, never 'to'.

items.prompt_en: By December, she will work here for exactly ten years
items.explain_en: A duration completed by a future point takes the future perfect.

items.prompt_en: I would have a Blackberry before smartphones took over
items.explain_en: 'would' cannot describe a past state like owning something — use 'used to'.

items.prompt_en: The manager said the release is delayed until next quarter
items.explain_en: Reported speech backshifts present 'is' to past 'was'.

items.prompt_en: I have seen that error yesterday in the staging logs
items.explain_en: A finished time like 'yesterday' takes the past simple, not the present perfect.

sessions.title: Choose & Fill
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the correct option or chip.

items.prompt_en: By the time the audit starts, we ___ all the security gaps.
items.explain_en: Completed before a future deadline → future perfect.

items.prompt_en: She told me she ___ the design doc the night before.
items.explain_en: Reported speech pushes the past one step further back: past perfect.

items.prompt_en: Careful — the intern ___ the production org right now.
items.explain_en: 'right now' → present continuous.

items.prompt_en: When I joined, I ___ check Stack Overflow ten times a day.
items.explain_en: 'would' works for a repeated past action (a routine).

items.prompt_en: We ___ three regressions since the last release.
items.explain_en: 'since the last release' connects past to now → present perfect.

items.prompt_en: The lights went out while we ___ the demo.
items.explain_en: A background action in progress → past continuous.

items.prompt_en: Relax — I ___ you when the build finishes.
items.explain_en: An on-the-spot promise takes 'will'.

items.prompt_en: He ___ at RocketPhone before he moved to the platform team.
items.explain_en: The earlier of two past actions takes the past perfect.

items.prompt_en: My eyes hurt because I ___ at dashboards all morning.
items.explain_en: Present perfect continuous explains a present result of a long action.

items.prompt_en: She said she ___ handle the on-call shift that weekend.
items.explain_en: Reported speech backshifts 'can' to 'could'.

sessions.title: Build It
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the tiles in the right order. For speak items, say it out loud.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: I have been debugging this flow since breakfast .
items.explain_en: Present perfect continuous: have been + verb-ing for an ongoing action.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: By Friday we will have migrated every record .
items.explain_en: Future perfect: will have + past participle for a future deadline.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: She said the patch had fixed the login bug .
items.explain_en: Reported speech backshifts past simple to past perfect.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: While I was testing , the network went down .
items.explain_en: Past continuous background + past simple interruption.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: I used to write code without any tests .
items.explain_en: 'used to' + base verb for a past habit that ended.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: We are meeting the client after the standup .
items.explain_en: Present continuous for a fixed arrangement.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: He had already left when the alert fired .
items.explain_en: Past perfect for the action that happened first.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: She will have been coding for ten years by June .
items.explain_en: Future perfect continuous: will have been + verb-ing for a duration up to a future point.

items.prompt_en: Say what you were doing when your last meeting started.
items.model_en: I was reviewing a pull request when the meeting started.

items.prompt_en: Report one thing your manager said this week, backshifting the tense.
items.model_en: My manager said the roadmap was almost final.

sessions.title: Mixed Drill
sessions.instruction_en: All four types, shuffled. Beat the clock.

items.prompt_en: The release is going to fails if we skip the smoke tests
items.explain_en: 'going to' takes the base verb.

items.prompt_en: I ___ this laptop in 2023, and it still runs fine.
items.explain_en: A finished time (2023) → past simple.

items.prompt_en: This time tomorrow, we ___ the new release at the all-hands.
items.explain_en: 'This time tomorrow' → future continuous for an action in progress.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: He told me he had tested the flow twice .
items.explain_en: Reported speech: past simple backshifts to past perfect.

items.prompt_en: She has been wrote documentation all afternoon
items.explain_en: Present perfect continuous = has/have been + verb-ing.

items.prompt_en: There ___ be a free snack bar on this floor, but they removed it.
items.explain_en: A past state that ended → 'used to', not 'would'.

items.prompt_en: I ___ home when the on-call alert went off.
items.explain_en: An interrupted background action → past continuous.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: She rarely checks her email before the standup .
items.explain_en: A habit takes the present simple; frequency adverb before the verb.

items.prompt_en: We realized the script had ran twice on the same records
items.explain_en: Past perfect = had + past participle: 'had run'.

items.prompt_en: Look at those clouds — it ___ rain any minute.
items.explain_en: Evidence you can see → 'going to' for predictions.
